name: Whitney Tiller
aboutCred: RN · IBCLC · DEM · BSM · RM(UK) · Tongue Tie Practitioner
homeBlurb: From the UK’s NHS to the Pacific Northwest, I’ve spent over a decade supporting parents and babies. To me this is so much more than a job, it’s a calling.

bio.text: I have been working in birth, supporting mothers, parents, and babies for over 13 years. I have such a deep passion and respect for birth in all its forms, and that passion shines through in what I do.
I want nothing more than to support you and provide the strategies you need to reach your infant feeding goals, whatever they may be.

timeline.title: Breastfeeding Peer Support Counselor
timeline.text: My journey in infant feeding began in the UK’s National Health Service.

timeline.title: Registered Midwife
timeline.text: Trained as a midwife, then became a Tongue Tie Practitioner treating 400 to 500 infants a year.

timeline.title: Infant Feeding Specialist Midwife
timeline.text: Trained staff, launched skin-to-skin initiatives, and helped my trust earn UNICEF Baby Friendly accreditation.

timeline.title: IBCLC certification
timeline.text: Completed my International Board Certified Lactation Consultant credential.

timeline.title: Pacific Northwest
timeline.text: Relocated and began supporting families through the Andaluz and Astoria birth centers and Wildflower Lactation.
